action.objective: Develop a knight to f3, improving kingside activity and preparing castling.
action.rationale: e2e3 is the only commit_ready_move (exact depth-4 score 0 with full safety). However, broad search at depth 3 already flagged g1f3 (score 14, exact) as strong development. e2e3 blocks the f1 bishop and offers little; g1f3 develops a minor, controls d4/e5, and enables castling. It was only searched at depth 3 with no single-candidate verification, so I must not commit it blindly. Budget permits one verification within verification_nodes_available.
